rationale: Trip Delay (wording section 3) applies: the carrier confirms a 30 hour 15 minute delay from the scheduled Belgrade departure on 20 July 2026 caused by severe weather (flash flooding), well past the First plan's 3-hour waiting period, and the claim was filed 16 days after the incident. The $85 Paris rebooking receipt is paid in full, and as the meals have no receipts they are paid at the manual's flat rate of $35 per traveler per 24-hour period or part of it, so 2 days x $35 x 1 traveler = $70, giving $155; no deductible applies to Trip Delay and this is well under the $1,500 First maximum.
